raw_context:
MediMark Europe (often operating as MediMark Europe Sarl, based in Grenoble, France) is not a standard commercial product distributor or brand reseller. Instead, it functions as an official
European Authorized Representative (EC REP)
and regulatory compliance service provider for international (non-European) medical device and in vitro diagnostic (IVD) manufacturers wanting to sell in the EU market. Because they act in a regulatory/legal representation capacity rather than listing a public catalog of consumer brands, they do not publicly retail or distribute specific third-party commercial labels, though they service numerous international diagnostics and medical tech companies (such as US-based manufacturer
Streck
and various global biological/diagnostic controls providers).
Med Device Online
Key Facts Overview
Core Function:
Acts as an official European Authorized Representative (EC REP) fulfilling regulatory requirements under EU Medical Devices Directives (MDD/MDR) and In Vitro Diagnostic Regulations (IVDR).
Med Device Online
Location:
Grenoble, France.
Founded:
1995.
Med Device Online
Primary Services:
Regulatory affairs guidance, quality management systems support, market readiness compliance, EUDAMED registration assistance, and incident/vigilance reporting liaison with European competent authorities.
Associated Biological Materials:
They also provide or source specific reference microorganisms/biological indicator strains used for laboratory validation and sterilization monitoring.
